name: The Chariot's Spire
desc:
The indomitable tower sprawls into the vast depths below, welcoming all to its sinful grasp.

The Chariot's Spire is an [Ignition Union](faction:the_ignition_union) base within [Scyphozia](location:first_layer). It is sparsely populated, and serves as a resupply point for Deepdelvers journeying into The [Eternal Gale](location:second_layer).
additional_info: -   Despite what the game says, the Chariot's Spire is not a lawless territory. Attacking players or guards has consequences.
